title: Kuphume i-Kyber 0.29
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: I-Kyber 0.29 yenza ukulawula ngesikhathi sangempela kube lula ukukusebenzisa, kucace kakhudlwana ukukubona, futhi kulungele izindawo eziningi.
html:
I-Kyber 0.29: xhuma ezindaweni eziningi, ubone ngokucacile, ulawule kangcono

Nge-Kyber 0.29, kulula ukusetha ukulawula ngesikhathi sangempela, isithombe sicace kakhudlwana, futhi uhlelo selusebenza ezindaweni eziningi. I-WebSocket eyakhelwe ngaphakathi yenza i-Kyber ifinyelele kumanethiwekhi ezinkampani amaningi. Ukufaka ividiyo ngekhodi engu-4:4:4 kugcina imininingwane yesithombe ngaphandle kokunciphisa inani lamaphikseli. Izindlela ezintsha zokuthwebula izithombe zona zivula ithuba lokusebenzisa i-Kyber ku-Raspberry Pi nakumadivayisi asemaphethelweni enethiwekhi. Le nguqulo iphinde ibeke isisekelo sokuphatha imishini eminingi ye-Kyber ndawonye.

Nanku umehluko ozowubona uma uyisebenzisa.

I-Kyber isiyasebenza nasemanethiw ekh i abeyivimba

Uma inethiwekhi ithi cha

Ngokuvamile i-Kyber ixhuma nge-QUIC, iphrothokholi yesimanje yenethiwekhi eyakhelwe ukuxhuma ngesivinini. Yingakho i-Kyber iphendula ngokuphazima kweso. Inkinga ukuthi amanye amanethiwekhi ezinkampani ayayivimba i-QUIC, kanti amanye awayamukeli nhlobo. Uma uzama ukufinyelela emshinini ovikelwe uhlelo olubeka imingcele eqinile ekuxhumaneni kwenethiwekhi, ubungakwazi nhlobo ukuxhuma.

I-Kyber ithola enye indlela nge-WebSocket

I-Kyber 0.29 isingaxhuma nange-WebSocket, indinganiso eyamukelwa cishe yiwo wonke amanethiwekhi. Uma inethiwekhi ivimba i-QUIC, i-Kyber ishintshela ku-WebSocket ikwazi ukuxhuma. Ukuxhumana kuhamba kancane kancane kunange-QUIC, kodwa uhlala uxhumekile. Usakwazi ukulawula umshini, noma ngabe ithini imigomo yokusebenzisa izinhlelo zolwazi.

I-WebSocket isiyingxenye yohlelo lwe-Kyber olufakwa kukhompyutha. Lolu hlelo nolwesiphequluli asebenzisa ikhodi efanayo yokuxhuma, ngakho uma leyo khodi ithuthukiswa, zombili izinguqulo zizuza ngesikhathi esisodwa.

Isithombe esicace kakhudlwana: lonke iphikseli, wonke umbala, kunoma yimuphi umshini

Kungani isithombe somshini okude sivame ukufiphala?

Ukonga umthamo wenethiwekhi, izinhlelo eziningi zokusakaza ividiyo zigcina imininingwane yombala ngamaphikseli ambalwa kunalawo eziwagcinela imininingwane yokukhanya. Uma ubuka ifilimu, akekho oqaphelayo. Uma usebenza, umehluko uvele uzibonakalele: kuba nzima ukufunda amaseli amancane eshidini lezibalo, imibala ehlonza umkhiqizo iyashintsha, nemigqa emincane emifanekisweni enezinhlangothi ezintathu iyahlangana.

Umbala ogcwele ngo-4:4:4, ngaphandle kokunciphisa amaphikseli

I-Kyber 0.29 ifaka ividiyo ngekhodi engu-4:4:4, ngakho iphikseli ngalinye ligcina umbala walo njengoba unjalo. Umbhalo ufundeka kahle, izinkinobho neminye imininingwane yohlelo kucaca bha, nemibala ayiguquki. Lokhu kusebenza ngisho nasemishinini izingxenye zayo zezithombe ezingakwazi ukufaka ividiyo ngekhodi engu-4:4:4 ngokwazo.

I-Kyber ayisazinciphisi nezikrini ezinkulu. Kuze kube manje, uma uhlelo ngokwalo belufaka ividiyo ngekhodi, belunciphisa noma yisiphi isithombe esibanzi kunamaphikseli angu-1920 sibe ngamaphikseli angu-1920 ububanzi nangu-1080 ukuphakama. Lowo mkhawulo awusekho. Isithombe sesikrini esingu-4K sesisakazwa ngo-4K.

Ishidi lakho lezibalo lihlala lifundeka, noma ngabe livulwe kumuphi umshini.

Ukulawula ngesikhathi sangempela emishinini eminingi, ngisho naku-Raspberry Pi

Iseva ye-Kyber isiyakwazi ukuthwebula izithombe nge-GStreamer, iqoqo lamathuluzi asetshenziswa kakhulu ukuphatha umsindo nevidiyo kumadivayisi akhelwe ukwenza imisebenzi ethile. Le nguqulo ikhetha kangcono izingxenye zomshini ezizokwenza umsebenzi, iphatha kangcono izithombe ezakha ividiyo, futhi ithatha isikhathi esincane ukufaka ividiyo ngekhodi. Ilungisa nenkinga ebibangela ukuthi uhlelo luvaleke kungazelelwe uma lusebenzisa amakhadi ezithombe e-Intel Arc.

Lezi zinguquko zisisiza sivumelanise i-Kyber kahle ne-Raspberry Pi namanye amadivayisi amancane angadli ugesi omningi. Kubalulekile lokho kumarobhothi, ezindizeni ezingenamshayeli nakuwo wonke amadivayisi asemaphethelweni enethiwekhi, lapho kudingeka khona ukuthi i-Kyber isakaze ngaphandle kokulibala okutheni yize imishini ingenawo amandla amakhulu. Maduzane kuzotholakala ku-GitLab iphakheji eyenzelwe i-Raspberry Pi ngokukhethekile.

Ukulawula kangcono: isisekelo sokuphatha imishini eminingi ye-Kyber

Sakha ingosi ezokwenza amaqembu akwazi ukubona nokulawula yonke imishini ye-Kyber endaweni eyodwa. I-Kyber 0.29 ibeka isisekelo salokho.

Umshini ngamunye uyazibika

Uhlelo olusha olusebenza emshinini ngamunye we-Kyber luthumela isaziso esifushane cishe njalo ngemizuzwana engu-10, luveze ukuthi umshini uxhumekile futhi ukulungele ukusebenza. Uma izaziso zinqamuka, uyazi ukuthi umshini awutholakali. Akudingeki uqagele noma uzihlolele wena.

Hlala ungene ngaphandle kokungena kabusha

Uma ukuxhumana sekuqinisekisiwe, amathokheni ashintshaniswa futhi avuselelwe ngokuzenzakalela. Ithokheni isebenza njengemvume yesikhashana yedijithali. I-Kyber iyivuselela ungaphazamiseki, ukuze ukuxhumana okuvikelekile kuqhubeke ngaphandle kokuthi abasebenzisi bangene kabusha.

Chofoza kanye uxhumane nge-kyber://

I-Kyber isinohlobo lwayo lwezixhumanisi. Chofoza isixhumanisi esiqala ngo-kyber:// esipheqululini, ku-imeyili noma kuphaneli yokulawula. Uhlelo lwe-Kyber olusekhompyutheni luzovuleka luxhume ngqo emshinini ofanele.

Sekulula ukufaka i-Kyber ku-macOS

Iseva ye-Kyber ye-macOS isitholakala njengephakheji ephelele. Sekulula ukuyifaka nokuyisabalalisa kuma-Mac amaningi. Okulandelayo yiphakheji esebenza ngokugcwele nenesiginesha yedijithali, i-macOS ezoyethemba zisuka nje.

Okunye okuthuthukisiwe nokulungisiwe

  • Umsindo: i-Opus, efaka umsindo ngekhodi iphinde iwufunde, isikunguqulo engu-1.6.1.
  • Ukuvikeleka: i-OIDC, indinganiso evumela ukungena kanye ukuze usebenzise izinhlelo ezahlukene, isinenketho yokuhlola ukuthi ithokheni iqondiswe kuluphi uhlelo. I-Kyber isingaqinisekisa ukuthi ithokheni yokungena ikhishwe yenzelwe yona, hhayi olunye uhlelo.
  • Izitifiketi: i-Kyber isihlola ukuxhumana okuvikelekile isebenzisa uhlu lwezitifiketi oluthenjwa uhlelo oluyisisekelo lomshini wakho.
  • Uhlelo lwesiphequluli: ukukhiya isikhombi segundane sekusebenza kahle emidlalweni esifihlayo.
  • VLC: isici sokugcina ividiyo okwesikhashana sesisebenzisana ne-VideoToolbox, uhlelo lwe-Apple olusebenzisa izingxenye zomshini ukufunda ividiyo efakwe ngekhodi.
  • Ukusebenza okuthembekile: uhlelo seluvala kahle uma singekho isibonisi, ukuxhumana kuvaleka ngokushesha, kulungiswe nenkinga yokwakha uhlelo nge-GCC 16, kanti namarekhodi okusebenza asenemiyalezo embalwa.

Thola i-Kyber 0.29

I-Kyber 0.29 isiyatholakala. Konke okudingayo ukuze uqale kulapha emibhalweni ye-Kyber.
